entries.en: student; scholar; a man of letters

entries.zh: 士类，文士之流；读书人这一阶层
entries.en: the scholar class; men of letters collectively

entries.notes: H 栏「密下」与 M 栏四音节音写（tag ěl choŋ hě）不能对应，仅 L 栏可据，释义权作「读书人」。

entries.zh: 士子，学子；（R 栏注）读书人的子弟
entries.en: young scholar; a scholar's son (per the Spanish note)
entries.notes: R 栏作西语「读书人之子」而非官话对音，与 H「士子」并存，故并出「学子」「士人之子」两义。

entries.en: a shi is a reader; a scholar is a man of learning

entries.zh: 有才具的读书人；科甲人物（有科第之望者）
entries.en: scholar of good parts; examination-caliber scholar
entries.notes: L「deprendas」为「de prendas」（有才具者）连写，H「科甲人物」指有科第前程的读书人。

entries.en: to pass the civil examination; to take a degree
entries.notes: L 与上条重复作 estudiante de prendas，H 却为「登科」，词头与汉字义不合，取汉字义。
L「E sudiar」之 E 为页眉音节提示（E ante t），实即 Estudiar；H 原字残泐（省/看），M「cua chě」证为「看冊」，另有 T99 污损，故降。

entries.en: to apply oneself to one's books; to study hard
to study diligently in one's study

entries.zh: 举业——为应科举、求功名而读书
entries.en: examination studies; to study for the examinations leading to office
the Eternal; eternal; without beginning or end
entries.notes: L「E Terno」为「Eterno」因页眉音节断行；H 与 M 互证「无起头无煞尾」，句中有 T99 污损，故降。
L 第三形「eternica」不可考（疑为 eterno／eternidad 之派生拼写），只取前两形之义。
